name: Astral Foods Limited
summary: Astral Foods Limited operates as an integrated poultry producer in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through Poultry and Feed segments. It also engages in the marketing, sale, and distribution of fresh and frozen poultry products; broiler genetics and integrated breeder; engaged in the abattoir and further processing operations; and sale of day-old chicks and hatching eggs. The company also produces and sells feed products for farmed animal species; and provides laboratory analytical services to the animal feed industry.
